report: Revision Kohn-Sham reference solver (independent Python, staggered finite differences + Richardson): self-checks

checks.name: theory_input_coefficients
checks.detail: ks-theory.json (sha256 41c16878199cfcea): M_eff = m + 15/16 lambda S, v_v = -1/16 lambda n, e_int = lambda[15/32 S^2 + -1/32 n^2] (Hartree 1/2 plus the uniform-gas exchange -1/32, -1/32); consistent: M_eff - m = d e_int/dS (15/16 = 15/16), v_v = d e_int/dn (-1/16 = -1/16): True

checks.name: free_k0_analytic_spectra
checks.detail: k = 0, constant M, v = 0, theta_tip = 0 (ks-theory.json boundaryConditions.exactK0Spectra), (m, L) = (1, 3), (1, 2), (2, 3), ranks -3..5 of both parities and both block types: Richardson (G = 300, 600, 1200) max |error| 2.842e-14 (tolerance 1e-11; max stated U 7.83e-10); single grids: G = 150: 3.733e-03, G = 300: 9.332e-04, G = 600: 2.333e-04, G = 1200: 5.833e-05, G = 2400: 1.458e-05

checks.detail: k = 0: the spectra of j = +1 and j = -1 agree to 0.0e+00 and the zero-mode profiles to 0.0e+00 (exact discrete symmetry w -> -w of the staggered scheme; tolerance 1e-13)

checks.detail: d eps/dk at k = 0 of the even j = +1 brane band (discrete Hellmann-Feynman, Richardson) equals ks-theory.json c e^(-a4,0) at a4,0 = [0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0] to 2.56e-15 relative (tolerance 1e-11); the formula reproduces checksNumeric.braneBandSlope_M1_H1_L3_a0 to 0.0e+00

checks.name: free_particle_branch
checks.detail: shells n2 <= 30 at every slice (G = 300): the lowest particle index (count of free levels below -1e-9) has eps > 0 (the k = 0 even zero mode: eps = 0), the index below has eps < 0; violations 0; closest level to zero away from the zero modes 0.0642 m (required > 1e-3)
